Package io.telekom.orchest.enginecore.bpmn.utils

Class BPMNUtils

java.lang.Object
io.telekom.orchest.enginecore.bpmn.utils.BPMNUtils
public class BPMNUtils extends Object
Utility class for working with BPMN models using the Zeebe BPMN model API. Provides methods for parsing, manipulating, and extracting information from BPMN XML.

    • addStrokes

      public static String addStrokes(io.camunda.zeebe.model.bpmn.BpmnModelInstance bpmnModelInstance, Map<String,io.telekom.orchest.api.core.model.bpmn.ExecutionLogEntry> sequenceExecutions)
      Adds visual highlighting (strokes) to the BPMN diagram based on execution history. Used to visualize the path taken by a process instance.
      Parameters:
      bpmnModelInstance - The BPMN model instance to modify.
      sequenceExecutions - A map of execution logs, used to identify executed sequence flows.
      Returns:
      The modified BPMN XML string with styling applied.

    • getProcessId

      public static String getProcessId(io.camunda.zeebe.model.bpmn.BpmnModelInstance bpmnModelInstance)
      Extracts the process ID from a BPMN model instance. Assumes the model contains at least one process definition.
      Parameters:
      bpmnModelInstance - The BPMN model instance.
      Returns:
      The ID of the first process found in the model.

    • isConnectorTask

      public static boolean isConnectorTask(io.telekom.orchest.api.core.model.bpmn.node.BaseNode node)
      Checks if a node is configured as a connector task. Connector tasks are identified by the presence of the IS_CONNECTOR property.
      Parameters:
      node - The node to check.
      Returns:
      true if the node is a connector task, false otherwise.
